function.arguments: {"explanation": "Archive-only rationale: the packet's clearest recurring failure is misdiagnosis. The P-format cohort showed invalid_output caused by a formatter-token defect inside _fmt (operator_syntax at index 0), repaired by a single tokenizer normalization edit that flipped 10/10 development tasks to valid plans, while the P-empty cohort's semantically wrong goal check returned plan_length 0 (goal_unsatisfied) with executed_actions 0 \u2014 no failure was ever observed in execution, so a syntax-level narrative there is unsupported. That argues for anchoring on the earliest actually observed failure and not inferring causes from proposed-plan length (R02), then requiring that each diagnostic observation be tied to a concrete source location and to the failure it should remove, verified in the submitted source (R05) \u2014 which is exactly what distinguished the successful format patch from the never-failing whitespace probe. R01 precedes both because input/output type and format checks are the cheapest discriminator between operator_syntax and plan_semantics.
